scope: Corollary 6.4 (Smooth invariant direct image) of the manuscript “Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary” (preprints/Integrable-metrics-and-effectivity-with-controlled-boundary-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79cff3abcc899987), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The conclusion of Proposition 6.3 remains valid if its ordinary rank-one hypothesis is replaced by rank f∗OZ(KZ/X) T = 1, provided that a compact torus T acts holomorphically on X and Z, acts trivially on Y , preserves f, g, and the smooth metric h, and all canonical bundles carry their natural linearizations.
